activity_statements.statement: provides civil and transportation engineering, planning, and development consulting for public infrastructure and private real estate clients nationwide
designs transportation infrastructure including roads, highways, roundabouts, traffic signal systems, and pedestrian/bicycle facilities for government agencies and developers
supports private real estate development projects from site planning through entitlement and infrastructure design for commercial, mixed-use, and industrial clients
delivers fully integrated multi-discipline design on projects of all scales across local, regional, and national initiatives with 90%+ repeat client rate

name_reality_gap: The 'Construction & Engineering' index label is misleading — Kimley-Horn is an engineering consulting and design firm, not a construction contractor. It designs and plans infrastructure but does not build it. The name itself carries no industry signal.
extraction_notes: About page described culture, client relationships, and practice scope but was fairly high-level. Specific service line and market detail known from public information; about page confirmed positioning. No careers page retrieved for function mix evidence.
